title: Running the TermAl binary with no subcommand (as agents probing TERMAL_CLI do) attempts to start a host server; --help and help fail with 'unknown argument'
outcome: Invoking TERMAL_CLI (the termal binary) the way an agent would never starts a host server. A bare invocation, or one with --help or help, prints usage listing the supported subcommands and exits non-zero (or zero for help) without touching the data directory. Starting the server requires an explicit, unambiguous form that agent guidance never uses.
acceptance: Running the TermAl binary with no subcommand (as agents probing TERMAL_CLI do) attempts to start a host server; --help and help fail with 'unknown argument' is done
